**1. MATCH: Partial pass.**
- Clouds are discrete billows, not a continuous deck — good. They cluster along the horizon band with individual puffs around x≈150, x≈470, x≈600, x≈700 (all y≈110–170).
- Blue gap coverage: roughly 45–55% of the sky band is blue sky — consistent with the 0.25 coverage preset's intent.
- Brightness: billow cores reach ~235–250 (near-white), but there is very little brightness *range*. Undersides are only ~200–220; the clouds read somewhat flat/washed, closer to a layered stratus-cumulus look than strongly puffy cumulus. Borderline rather than clean pass.

**2. ARTIFACTS:**
- Mild vertical banding/streaking in the blue sky at upper-left (x≈10–120, y≈10–60) — soft vertical smear stripes.
- Slight horizontal banding in the upper-right blue region (x≈700–940, y≈10–50).
- No speckle, no chroma (cyan/magenta) blotches, no visible tiling/duplication, no hard seams between billows.

**3. SUN SHADING: FAIL / very weak.**
Light from upper right is not clearly expressed. Example: the billow cluster at x≈440–520, y≈100–140 shows its upper-right face only marginally brighter (~245) than its lower-left base (~205–215). The cluster at x≈580–660, y≈120–160 is nearly uniform (~230 across). Directional contrast is present but subtle — below what "visibly darker undersides" requires.

**4. CLIPPING:**
No large flat pure-white clipped regions in the sky band. The only large white area is the fog-faded floor below the horizon line (bottom ~45%), which is excluded per instructions. Cloud cores stay ≤ ~250, so no blowout.

**Verdict:** Conditional pass — geometry and coverage match, but shading contrast is weak and there is mild banding/streaking in the blue sky.
